requirements.text: The system shall provide a common repository for traffic information for the DFW Metroplex.
The system shall provide a World Wide Web based graphical map to display traffic conditions.
The system shall provide a Microsoft Windows application for agencies without a formal TMC to participate in information sharing.
The system shall support command, control, and status monitoring for ITS field devices including DMS, LCS, CCTV, Ramp Meters, and HAR.
The system shall implement interfaces for Roadway Network, Traffic Conditions, Incident Data, Lane Closures, and various field devices using ITS standards.
The system shall support user authentication via username and password for device control commands.
The system shall provide a mechanism to request and receive command timeframe availability for specific devices.
The system shall support the storage of TMDD data elements and message sets.
The system shall provide an Incident GUI for entering and modifying incident and lane closure information.
The system shall provide a Remote Control GUI for executing device control requests over a public network.
The system shall utilize TCP/IP for data transmission.
The system shall utilize DATEX/ASN for transmitting TMDD message sets.
The system shall require user authentication for all device control commands.
The web map shall allow users to pan and zoom the graphical display.
The web map shall color-code roadway links based on speed values.
The system shall be designed to allow linking of local, regional, and statewide repositories.
The system shall be implemented using National ITS standards, specifically the Traffic Management Data Dictionary (TMDD).
The system shall operate in either a normal mode for operations or a test mode for development and logging.
The system shall execute in a Microsoft Windows NT environment and be implemented in C/C++.
